meta.disclaimer: Passport-specific summaries are for trip planning only. Immigration rules change without notice — always confirm with the official source for your nationality before booking flights.

uk.label: Visa-free 90 days
uk.note: Tourism up to 90 days. Passport valid 30 days beyond departure; two blank pages. Minors need unabridged birth certificate.

us.label: Visa-free 90 days
us.note: Same as UK — 90-day tourism. Yellow fever certificate if arriving from endemic countries.

eu.label: Visa-free 90 days
eu.note: EU/Schengen passport holders typically receive 90-day visa-free entry.

ca.label: Visa-free 90 days
ca.note: Canadian passport holders typically visa-free 90 days.

za.label: Citizen / resident
za.note: South African citizens — ID or passport. SADC visitors check DHA list for visa-free days.

sadc.label: Usually visa-free
sadc.note: Most SADC nationals visa-free for tourism — confirm days allowed on DHA list.

in.label: Visa required
in.note: Indian nationals require a visa before travel — apply via VFS or DHA channels.

other.label: Check official list
other.note: Verify your nationality on the Department of Home Affairs visa exemption list.

kazaTip.label: KAZA UniVisa tip
kazaTip.note: Eligible passports: USD 50 cash on arrival at Livingstone, Victoria Falls, or Kazungula — 30 days unlimited ZM↔ZW crossings plus same-day Chobe day trips. Does not cover overnight Botswana stays. See cross-border guide in Transport hub.
